_doc: More god-layer stills beyond god.json (CONTRACT §15.6–15.8): the throw arc while aiming, an uprooted tree in the Touch, a boulder hurled mid-flight seen from the god's height (readable: present.ts), a firestorm at dusk, a locust swarm, plague over a town, a glowing rift and a sinkhole, a comet over the night side, the sky-paint brush, and the compositing regressions (alpha-tested foliage in front of a ward and inside fog). Lookdev world, staged by script; FX time moved with window.__GENESIS_FX__.advance. Run: node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/specs/god-extra.json

shots.name: godx-throw-arc
script: document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); G.ui_.closeAll(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = true; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 14, regard: 0.5, pose: 'open' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', kind: 'rock', mass: 2600 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 120, tilt: 58, yaw: 0, fov: 55, hour: 15 });
await G.frames(2); window.__GENESIS_APP__.ui.hand.beginAim(); G.ui_.pointer(560, 330); await G.frames(4);
return { aiming: window.__GENESIS_APP__.ui.hand.isAiming, held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId], arc: F.fx.hand.u.uArcK.value };

shots.name: godx-hand-tree
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; window.__GENESIS_APP__.ui.hand.cancelAim(); window.__GENESIS_APP__.ui.pointerLeave(); G.ui_.closeAll(); F.fx.hand.force = true; const p = G.poi('forest-edge');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 22, regard: 0.7, pose: 'open' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', kind: 'tree', mass: 1 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (40 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 16, yaw: 0, pitch: 4, fov: 55, hour: 15.5 });
await G.frames(4); return { held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId], scale: F.fx.hand.scale };

shots.name: godx-throw-flight
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; window.__GENESIS_APP__.ui.hand.cancelAim(); window.__GENESIS_APP__.ui.pointerLeave(); G.ui_.closeAll(); F.fx.hand.force = true; const p = G.poi('farm');

await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 14, regard: 0.6, pose: 'open' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', kind: 'rock', mass: 2600 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 260, tilt: 60, yaw: 0, fov: 55, hour: 15 }); await G.frames(2);

const up = p.pos, el = Math.hypot(up[2], up[0]) || 1, E = [up[2] / el, 0, -up[0] / el]; const v = [E[0] * 20 + up[0] * 20, E[1] * 20 + up[1] * 20, E[2] * 20 + up[2] * 20]; await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.throw', vel: v }); await G.step(1); await G.frames(1); const nf = () => { let n = 0; F.fx.m.flights.forEach(() => n++, F.fx.clock); return n; }; for (let i = 0; i < 8 && !nf(); i++) await G.frames(1); F.advance(1.2); await G.frames(1);
let fl = []; F.fx.m.flights.forEach((id, kind, q, v, age) => fl.push({ id, kind, age: +age.toFixed(2), d: Math.round(q.distanceTo(F.fx.vis.camBody)) }), F.fx.clock); return fl;

shots.name: godx-rift-sinkhole
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('valley');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });

await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'rift', pos: p.pos, offset: [0, 300], progress: 0.5 }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'sinkhole', pos: p.pos, offset: [450, -200], progress: 0.5, radius: 90 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 1500, tilt: 58, yaw: 0, fov: 60, hour: 19.6 });
await G.frames(2); F.advance(10); await G.frames(2);

shots.name: godx-comet
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'comet', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.75, bearing: 120 });
// the comet hangs a hundred kilometres up over the farm: seen from the night side 1.5 km off (on a world 3 km round), looking up past the horizon
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (1500 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 30, yaw: 0, pitch: 38, fov: 70, hour: 21.5 });
await G.frames(2); F.advance(4); await G.frames(2);

const st = [...F.fx.m.disasters.states.values()].find((x) => x.kind === 'comet'); const cm = st && st.extra.comet; const cam = window.__GENESIS_APP__.renderer.camera; const W = F.fx.vis.group.matrixWorld;
const scr = (v) => { const q = v.clone().applyMatrix4(W).project(cam); return [Math.round((q.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * innerWidth), Math.round((0.5 - q.y * 0.5) * innerHeight), +q.z.toFixed(4)]; };

return { comet: !!cm, head: cm ? scr(cm.u.uHead.value) : null, alt: cm ? Math.round(cm.u.uHead.value.length() - 3000) : null, len: cm ? Math.round(cm.u.uLen.value) : null, k: cm ? cm.u.uK.value : null };

shots.name: godx-sky-brush
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' }); F.advance(30); await G.frames(1);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', poi: 'farm', dist: 700, tilt: 50, hour: 13 });
const ok = G.ui_.arm('weather-thunderstorm'); G.ui_.pointer(400, 240); await G.frames(3); return { ok, brush: !!F.fx.brush };
